# Komboe

> Komboe is an open-source, zero-knowledge password manager (pre-release). Vaults are encrypted on-device with Encryptoglyph (Apache-2.0); servers store only ciphertext. The master password never leaves the device, there is no backdoor and no admin password reset. One Komboe account (email + master password, optional passkey and 2FA) covers the web vault, browser extensions, Android, desktop, CLI and an MCP agent integration. iOS is planned. Paid prices and release builds are not yet published.
